newsitem.title: USA: Conn. unemployment rate rises to 4.1 pct in Nov..
newsitem.headline: Conn. unemployment rate rises to 4.1 pct in Nov..

text.p: Connecticut's unemployment rate rose one percentage point to 5.1 percent in November, the state Labor Department said, mainly because the government and financial, insurance and real estate sectors shed jobs.
Still, the latest rate was down five percentage points from the year-ago rate for November of 5.6 percent.
A total of about 2,100 jobs were lost in the government sector, while finance, insurance and real estate trimmed 900 positions, trade cut 600 and construction and mining lost 200.
However, 1,100 jobs were added in durable goods, and 100 in non-durable goods, with the service sector gaining 1,100 positions and the transportation, communications, and utilities sector rising 500.
A breakdown of the unemployment rate by labor market areas follows.

New London, 5.1 percent, up from 4.9 percent.
